title: Ramp Launches Development Tool Inspect Following Internal Use for 74% of Code Merges
summary:
Ramp has converted its proprietary software building tool into a standalone product available for lauch on Oct. 27. The tool, called Inspect, was developed internally to accelerate the company's own coding workflows and passed through a design partner phase before being opened to other companies for public sign-up.

The software now serves as a primary engine for Ramp's internal production, with 74% of the code the company currently merges originating from Inspect, compared to nearly zero in November of last year. Every product Ramp shipped throughout the current year was built using the software.
